answer: Start from receipt proof for a remote transaction. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A prism of doubt is healthy, a fable of proof is required, and a pearl of patience is the price of a clean panel. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
